Description: Users must log in securely using username and password.
Users can search books by title, author, or ISBN.
Librarian can issue books to registered users.
Librarian can record returned books and update availability.
System maintains book details and availability.
Users can reserve currently unavailable books.
System sends due-date and overdue reminders.
Suggests books based on borrowing history.
Allow users to choose interface themes.
Provide chatbot assistance for library queries.
